# Sewage Clean Pros
> Sewage Clean Pros is a nationwide connection service that helps homeowners, landlords, property managers and businesses find independent sewage cleanup providers in the United States.

## Company
- Name: Sewage Clean Pros
- [Official website](https://www.sewagecleanpros.com/)
- Business model: Customer-to-provider referral and connection service, not a direct sewage cleanup contractor.
- Customers provide their ZIP code and describe the cleanup problem to request a connection where an independent provider is available.
- Provider availability, credentials, response times, estimates, prices and work performed are determined by independent providers; Sewage Clean Pros does not guarantee availability or arrival times.
- [Learn how it works](https://www.sewagecleanpros.com/how-it-works)

## Services customers can request help finding
- [Emergency sewage cleanup](https://www.sewagecleanpros.com/services/emergency-sewage-cleanup)
- [Sewage backup cleanup](https://www.sewagecleanpros.com/services/sewage-backup-cleanup)
- [Basement sewage cleanup](https://www.sewagecleanpros.com/services/basement-sewage-cleanup)
- [Water extraction](https://www.sewagecleanpros.com/services/water-extraction)

## Service areas
- [Browse state and city information](https://www.sewagecleanpros.com/locations)
- Coverage is location-dependent. A location page does not guarantee an independent provider is available.

## Helpful information
- [Sewage cleanup resources](https://www.sewagecleanpros.com/resources)
- The site provides information and connections; it does not replace qualified on-site evaluation or emergency services.

## Transparency and policies
- [Terms and disclaimer](https://www.sewagecleanpros.com/terms)
- [Privacy policy](https://www.sewagecleanpros.com/privacy)
- Sewage Clean Pros does not directly perform cleanup work and should not be described as a licensed restoration contractor or as owning the independent providers' equipment.
